title: VIXEN configure requires a manually selected Undertow worktree for generated textshader
body: The documented/default VIXEN configure selected /home/liory/projects/undertow, which lacked transpiled/textshader and failed at libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt:19. Recovery required manually locating a clean Undertow worktree with generated Text.g.h/text.g.glsl and exporting UNDERTOW_ROOT before reconfiguring. The VIXEN facade/build setup should declare and resolve the paired Undertow generated-interface artifact instead of relying on an undocumented neighboring worktree or a manual override.
